LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 14.3.1 SUBJECT- VERB AGREEMENT

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we construct sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the subject and the verb in sentences
2. construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the subject and the verb in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the subject and the verb in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement
   In simple words: practise until you can construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement.
4. Show that you can: identify the subject and the verb in sentences

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 14.3.1 Subject- Verb Agreement important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read texts on varied topics such as outdoor games and identify the subject and verbs in the sentences,
2. Read sentences and label subject- verb agreement in them,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the subject and the verb in sentences
2. construct sentences ensuring subject-verb agreement

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
